cells.docstring: Opens and identifies the given image file. Returns an Image object.

inputs.name: image_path
inputs.description: Path to the target image file on disk.

preconditions.description: Image file path must exist.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank RGB image with the given dimensions and solid color fill.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Image size specified as a (width, height) tuple.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Color fill tuple (R, G, B) or color name string.

preconditions.description: Size must be a 2-tuple of positive integers.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank RGBA image with alpha transparency support.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGBA color tuple (R, G, B, A). Defaults to fully transparent.

preconditions.description: Size must contain 2 elements.

cells.docstring: Creates a new blank 8-bit grayscale ('L' mode) image.

preconditions.description: Size must be 2D.

cells.docstring: Converts an image of any supported mode to 3-channel RGB color space.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Input Pillow image in any convertible mode.

preconditions.description: Input mode differs from RGB.

cells.docstring: Converts an image to RGBA format, adding an opaque alpha channel if none exists.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: Converted RGBA image with active alpha channel.

preconditions.description: Input mode is not RGBA.

cells.docstring: Converts an image to 8-bit single-channel grayscale ('L') via standard ITU-R 601-2 luma transform.

preconditions.description: Input image is not already grayscale.

cells.docstring: Converts image to 1-bit bilevel black and white ('1' mode) using dithering.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Input image to convert to bilevel bitmap.

cells.docstring: Converts image to 4-channel CMYK print separation mode.

preconditions.description: Input must be RGB.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow RGB Image to a NumPy ndarray preserving standard RGB channel order.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 3-channel uint8 numpy array in RGB order.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in RGB mode.

postconditions.description: Output is 3D array with 3 color channels.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow RGB Image to a NumPy ndarray reversing channels to BGR order (for OpenCV interoperability).

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 3-channel uint8 numpy array in BGR order.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in RGB mode.

postconditions.description: Array has 3 channels in BGR sequence.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Exports a Pillow grayscale ('L') Image to a single-channel 8-bit intensity NumPy array.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: 2D uint8 numpy array representing gray intensity.

preconditions.description: Image must strictly be in 'L' mode.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Ingests a BGR-ordered NumPy ndarray (e.g. from OpenCV) into a Pillow RGB Image by reversing channels.

preconditions.description: Input array must be 3-channel BGR.

cells.docstring: Bridge: Ingests a 2D intensity NumPy array into a Pillow grayscale ('L') Image.

preconditions.description: Input array must be 2D single channel.

cells.docstring: Resizes image to target dimensions using high-quality Lanczos resampling.

preconditions.description: Target dimensions must be strictly positive.

cells.docstring: Resizes image using bilinear interpolation for fast balanced scaling.
Resizes image using nearest-neighbor interpolation, ideal for masks and pixel art.
Crops a rectangular region from this image specified by a 4-tuple (left, upper, right, lower).

preconditions.expression: len(box) == 4 and box[2] > box[0] and box[3] > box[1]
preconditions.description: Box must contain 4 valid coordinates with right > left and lower > upper.

cells.docstring: Rotates image counter-clockwise by the specified angle in degrees.

inputs.name: expand
inputs.description: If true, expands the output image size to hold entire rotated content.

cells.docstring: Flips the image horizontally (left to right mirror).
Flips the image vertically (top to bottom mirror).
Rotates image 90 degrees counter-clockwise without resampling artifacts.
Applies Gaussian blur convolution filter with adjustable radius.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Standard deviation / kernel radius of the Gaussian filter.

preconditions.description: Radius must be non-negative.

cells.docstring: Applies Box blur filter where each pixel is set to the average value of its surrounding box.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Radius of the box filter window.

cells.docstring: Applies a predefined edge-finding kernel highlighting boundaries within the image.
Applies a predefined contour filter extracting outline boundaries.
Applies a predefined sharpening convolution filter.
Applies an unsharp mask filter to sharpen fine details without boosting noise.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Minimum brightness difference threshold to trigger sharpening.

cells.docstring: Applies a median filter for salt-and-pepper noise reduction.

inputs.name: size_val
inputs.description: Kernel size (must be an odd integer).

preconditions.description: Kernel size must be odd.

cells.docstring: Adjusts image contrast using ImageEnhance.Contrast with a multiplicative factor.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Contrast multiplier. 1.0 gives original, 0.0 gives flat solid gray.

preconditions.description: Enhancement factor must be non-negative.

cells.docstring: Adjusts image brightness using ImageEnhance.Brightness with a multiplicative factor.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Brightness multiplier. 0.0 gives black, 1.0 is unchanged.

preconditions.description: Factor must be non-negative.

cells.docstring: Adjusts color saturation balance using ImageEnhance.Color.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Saturation multiplier. 0.0 gives black and white, 1.0 is original.

preconditions.description: Color enhancement requires RGB mode.

cells.docstring: Adjusts sharpness continuously using ImageEnhance.Sharpness.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Sharpness factor. 0.0 gives blurred, 1.0 is original, 2.0+ is sharpened.

cells.docstring: Initializes an ImageDraw context bound in-place to an existing image canvas.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Image canvas to draw upon in-place.

outputs.name: output_var
outputs.description: Active drawing context tied to the image canvas.

postconditions.description: Draw context is valid and active.

cells.docstring: Renders a line or series of connected segments onto the active draw context.

inputs.name: xy
inputs.description: Sequence of 2-tuples [(x1, y1), (x2, y2)] or flat coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2].

cells.docstring: Renders a rectangle on the active draw context with optional fill and outline border.

inputs.name: xy
inputs.description: Bounding box coordinates as (x0, y0, x1, y1).

inputs.name: fill
inputs.description: Internal fill color or None for transparent interior.

preconditions.description: xy must define 4 coordinates.

cells.docstring: Renders an ellipse or circle within the bounding box onto the canvas.

inputs.name: xy
inputs.description: Bounding box coordinates (x0, y0, x1, y1).

cells.docstring: Renders text string onto the active image at specified origin coordinates.

inputs.name: fill
inputs.description: Text fill color tuple or hex string.

cells.docstring: Composites RGBA source image over RGBA destination image using alpha blending.

inputs.name: image_src
inputs.description: Foreground image in RGBA mode with identical dimensions.

preconditions.description: Both destination and source must be RGBA.
Both images must share identical dimensions.

cells.docstring: Creates a new image by interpolating between two images with constant weight alpha: out = image1*(1.0 - alpha) + image2*alpha.

preconditions.description: Both images must have identical mode and size.

cells.docstring: Composites two images using an explicit grayscale or binary mask image.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Grayscale mask defining pixel interpolation weights.

preconditions.description: All images and mask must match dimensions.

cells.docstring: Splits a 3-channel RGB image into separate single-channel band images (R, G, B).

outputs.name: output_r
outputs.description: Red channel band as grayscale image.

outputs.name: output_g
outputs.description: Green channel band as grayscale image.

outputs.name: output_b
outputs.description: Blue channel band as grayscale image.

preconditions.description: Input image must be RGB.

cells.docstring: Merges three single-channel grayscale bands into a single RGB color image.

preconditions.description: All bands must share the same resolution.

cells.docstring: Inverts pixel values of an image (creates a photographic negative).

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Input image to invert (RGB or L).

cells.docstring: Maximizes image contrast by mapping darkest pixels to black and lightest to white.

inputs.name: cutoff
inputs.description: Percentage of high/low histogram outliers to clip.

cells.docstring: Pads an image to fit requested dimensions preserving aspect ratio.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Color used for letterbox padding border.

cells.docstring: Crops and resizes image to target dimensions with centering.
Persists image to disk with format inferred from destination file extension.

preconditions.description: Destination path must not be empty.

cells.docstring: Exports image to JPEG format with customizable quality compression.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Image without alpha channel to save as JPEG.

preconditions.description: JPEG encoder cannot serialize RGBA alpha channels.

cells.docstring: Exports image to lossless PNG format with optional deflation optimization.

inputs.name: optimize
inputs.description: Whether to run optimization pass on PNG compressor.

cells.docstring: Displays the image using an external platform-specific desktop image viewer.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Image to present in GUI viewer.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Title string for the viewer window.
